description: This Kotlin source file defines the ProcessRemoteActions class, which manages remote note operations (create, update, delete) in a synchronized manner, handling concurrency, batching, and backend availability checks within a note-taking app.

classes.name: ProcessRemoteActions
classes.description: Manages processing of remote note operations with concurrency control, batching, and backend availability checks.

methods.name: invoke
methods.description: Processes a remote operation for a note, ensuring only the latest operation is executed, with batching and backend checks.

methods.name: deleteRemoteNotes
methods.description: Deletes a note remotely using the backend provider and updates local mappings.

methods.name: insertRemote
methods.description: Creates a new note remotely and updates local database with the new mapping and last modified timestamp.

methods.name: updateRemote
methods.description: Updates an existing note remotely and updates the local mapping.
